title: Ranger
notes: Waits ahead of the run. Holds a wide standoff off the crown and lobs a glowing purple orb after a one-second aim.

title: Ranger
notes: Longer standoff and a slightly quicker orb. Many bells can share a pack.

title: Ranger
notes: Harder tiles pack more bells. Orbs stay large and close faster.

title: Ranger
notes: Hard-patch bells still throw a purple orb from farther out.

title: Rhino
notes: Meteor strike only. Lines up on a slow target. Matches a runner with lag then cuts ahead into the intercept. Backs off if the player is too close.

title: Rhino
notes: Same meteor. Closes the lead a little sooner and hits harder.

title: Rhino
notes: Starts the meteor from farther out and keeps the lagged frame.

title: Rhino
notes: Hard patches field a crowd of chargers. Meteor comes out faster.

title: Rammer
notes: Waits ahead of travel and winds up from a stop into a dive once the player closes.

title: Rammer
notes: Appears a bit farther out on a fast run and reaches a higher ram speed.

title: Rammer
notes: Faster wind-up. Many eyeballs can share a pack.

title: Rammer
notes: Hard-patch rams hit harder and finish the dive sooner.

title: Rift-Hulk
notes: Box brute. Not called by field patches.

title: Rift-Hulk
notes: Tougher slam. Still a box spawn only.

title: Rift-Hulk
notes: Late-box hulk. Field patches still do not call it.

title: Gloam
notes: Two-winged flock on the castle and office grounds. Bites on the ground. Takes off if the player pulls away.

title: Gloam
notes: Tougher flock biters. Still only around Stormwatch and Meridian Tower.

title: Gloam
notes: Harder castle and office tiles pack more Gloam. Bite stays close-range.

title: Gloam
notes: Late castle and office flocks hit harder and stay on the player.

title: Vesper
notes: Four-winged patrol around Stormwatch and Meridian Tower. Locks a red telegraph beam before it fires.

title: Vesper
notes: Quicker lock on the castle and office grounds. Same telegraph

title: Vesper
notes: Harder castle and office tiles keep more Vespers in the air.

title: Vesper
notes: Late castle and office beams charge faster and hit harder.

title: Threnody
notes: Six-winged cursed giant on the castle and office grounds. One per pack. Drops shock columns.

title: Threnody
notes: Tougher cursed giant. Still only around Stormwatch and Meridian Tower.

title: Threnody
notes: Late castle and office tiles still field only one Threnody.

title: Threnody
notes: Hard-patch Threnody on the castle and office grounds. Columns drop a bit sooner.

title: Gruk
notes: Castle bruiser. Charges and swings. Preset pad. Does not respawn.

title: Gruk
notes: Tougher castle bruiser. Still a one-shot garrison pad.

title: Gruk
notes: Harder Gruk. Castle pads do not refill.

title: Gruk
notes: Late-tile Gruk. Same charge and swing.

title: Nix
notes: Smaller castle runner. Charges and swings. Does not respawn.

title: Nix
notes: Quicker Nix. Still a one-shot pad.

title: Nix
notes: Harder Nix. Castle pads stay empty after a kill.

title: Nix
notes: Late-tile Nix. Same melee rush.

title: Vex
notes: Holds the back line and lobs a red mortar from his staff. Does not respawn.

title: Vex
notes: Same staff mortar. Hits a bit harder.

title: Vex
notes: Harder Vex. Pads stay empty after a kill.

title: Vex
notes: Late-tile Vex. Red mortars from the staff tip.
